transcript.text: Thanks for calling Lakeside Family Clinic, this is Robin. How can I help?
Hi. I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can help you with scheduling an appointment for that. May I have your full name, please?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?

I’m sorry, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. However, I can help you book an appointment with the doctor to get your blood pressure medication refill. Would you like to schedule that? If so, please tell me your full name.
Okay. And can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?
I don’t have access to test results, but I can help you schedule an appointment to discuss your cholesterol and medication. Would you like to book a visit? If yes, please provide your full name.
You’re welcome! If you need anything else in the future, just give us a call. Have a great day!
